states.message: Welcome to Product knowledge! Please select a topic you would like to learn about.

A gold loan is a secured loan where the customer pledges gold jewelry/coins as collateral. Eligibility is simple — just valid ID and proof of gold ownership, no income proof required, which is why approval is usually same-day.
The loan amount is capped by RBI's Loan-to-Value rule — currently up to 75% of the gold's appraised value. The rest stays as a safety margin in case gold prices fall.
We offer bullet repayment (pay interest monthly, principal at closure), EMI schemes, and overdraft-style schemes where interest is charged only on the amount drawn.
Standard tenure is 6-12 months, renewable. Customers can prepay or foreclose anytime; part-payments reduce the interest burden immediately.
